title: The sum of the first odd integers

proof.title: The sum of the first odd integers is a square

steps.title: Verify the base case
steps.body: At $n=0$, the left-hand side is the empty sum, which equals $0=0^2$.

steps.title: Prove the induction step
steps.body: Fix an integer $n \ge 0$ and assume the formula holds for $n$. We prove it for $n+1$.

steps.title: Conclude by induction
steps.body: The base case and induction step establish the identity for every nonnegative integer.

hypotheses.title: Induction on the nonnegative integers
hypotheses.body: If $P(0)$ holds and $P(n)$ implies $P(n+1)$ for every $n \ge 0$, then $P(n)$ holds for all $n \ge 0$.
